messages:
sam: quick note from today's onboarding smoke for 'sparrow-mini-embed' (int6 profile). ran a focused quality + latency sweep before wider benching.

lina: parameters?

sam: dataset = 8k mixed (qa pairs, paraphrase, cross-lang pairs). quant mode=int6 asymmetric, per-tensor clip, calibrate_samples=20k, index=faiss IVF-PQ, probe=10. exact-cosine used for oracle.

omar: got any numbers? even a high-level summary helps.

eval-bot: job 1751239999_sparrow-smoke started by sam  status: completed  artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/sparrow/1751239999/

sam: paste of headline:
```
recall@1: 0.61
recall@5: 0.79
recall@10: 0.85
mean_cosine_gap_vs_fp32: -0.028
silhouette_macro: 0.16
silhouette_short_queries: 0.24
p99_latency_qps50: 48ms
index_disk_size: 1.1GB
```

lina: recall@5 nearly on par. mean_cosine_gap looks small but negative 1. Can you break down by source (qa/paraphrase/cross-lang)?

sam: sure: qa recall@5=0.83, paraphrase=0.77, cross-lang=0.69. cross-lang hit mostly low-resource pairs (kk, am).

omar: cross-lang drop is concerning for global customers. Did you try per-channel quant or increasing calib samples for subword buckets?

sam: not yet. next run plan: int6 per-channel + augment calib with language-specific samples (5k each low-resource). also will test L2 vs cosine during ANN recall validation.

lina: also check cluster visuals (UMAP) to see if dense islands formed for frequent tokens. those can bias NN.

sam: yes will dump UMAP + class-colored scatter. small snippet of eval artifact map: s3://redwood-evals/sparrow/1751239999/umap.png

eval-bot: follow-up job queued: 1751240200_sparrow-int6-perchannel (owner: sam)

omar: ops note: index size looks tiny which is good for cost, but verify PQ distortions at recall@1 before canarying.

sam: agreed. i'll run recall@1 per-route and include MRR and false-positive rate. keeping this variant behind internal flag until cross-lang recovers. opening ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/EMB-6201. tagging bench/localization.

lina: thanks. if per-channel helps, we can re-run a 50k stratified with warm-start and cold-start latency comparisons.

sam: sounds like a plan. will post results here when ready. :thumbsup:
